topic: Hiding from a car loan default vs using your repossession rights (Vince vs Della)

scenes.narration: In most states a lender can tow your car away without ever seeing a judge. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom pointing at a tow truck hauling away a small car, comic burst banner reads NO JUDGE NEEDED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Vince and Della each fall two months behind on their car loans.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split courtroom panel of man vince and woman della each holding a loan statement stamped TWO MONTHS BEHIND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Missed payments mean default, and repo agents need no court order.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an open law book on a courtroom bench titled DEFAULT AND REPOSSESSION, a wooden gavel resting beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Vince dodges the lender's calls and parks his sedan behind the house.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man vince ignoring a ringing phone and hiding a sedan behind a house, comic banner reads DODGING THE CALLS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A tow truck takes it from his driveway at three in the morning.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a tow truck lifting a sedan from a dark driveway at night, a clock labeled 3 AM in the corner, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Della calls her lender first and requests a written payment deferment.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman della on the phone at a desk writing on a form labeled WRITTEN DEFERMENT REQUEST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She also learns her state grants a right to reinstate the loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman della reading a glowing law page with a highlighted line reading RIGHT TO REINSTATE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Della pays the past due amount and keeps her car legally.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman della smiling beside her car holding a receipt stamped LOAN REINSTATED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Vince's car sells at auction for far less than he still owes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an auction podium with a sedan on a block, a price sign labeled SOLD FOR PENNIES, man vince watching in dismay, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The lender sues him for the deficiency balance plus towing fees.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man vince in a courtroom facing paperwork on the bench stamped DEFICIENCY BALANCE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Della drives to work while Vince pays for a car he lost.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of woman della cheerfully driving to work and man vince at a bus stop paying a bill labeled CAR HE NO LONGER HAS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Call your lender before default and ask about reinstatement in writing. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads CALL FIRST ASK IN WRITING, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
